meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装一个本地监控面板:安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard,把 pusher 模块与其测试复制到 src/,在 index.ts 的 main() 里插入一段启动代码,配好 .env 变量后构建、跑测试并重启服务。面板展示会话、渠道、日志等。
howto.when: 当你调用 /add-dashboard,或要求给 NanoClaw 加监控面板时接管;它会把这套安装与接线步骤跑一遍。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控面板
say.note: 安装 npm 包并插入启动代码

say.text: 把 dashboard 的启动代码接到 src/index.ts 里
say.note: 只改 main() 里那一处

say.text: 跑一下 dashboard 的构建和测试,再重启服务

howto.what_en: Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard into NanoClaw, copies the pusher module and its tests into src/, inserts one startup block in index.ts, sets .env vars, then builds, tests and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you invoke /add-dashboard or ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw; it runs the install-and-wire steps.

say_en.note: Installs the npm package and wires startup
